text: Figure 2.34: Software Packaging The existence of the SoftwareCluster (as outcome of Software Cluster Integration) by itself is not sufficient for installation. Actually , the SoftwareCluster gets wrapped into an Adaptive Software Package that comes with an own manifest format (the SW Package Description ) that is at least partly standardized. The difference between the semantics of a SoftwareCluster and the semantics of Adaptive Software Package is that a SoftwareCluster focuses on the struc- ture of the software itself while the Adaptive Software Package is created to han- dle the logistics aspect of the software installation.
